_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); revenue, margin, expense and receivables signals with Google's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'Alphabet is a collection of businesses -- the largest of which is Google.' 'We generate a significant portion of our revenues from advertising, and reduced spending by advertisers or a loss of partners could harm our advertising business.' 'We face intense competition.' 'As our growth rate has slowed, the cyclicality and seasonality in our business has become more pronounced and caused our operating results to fluctuate.' 'In addition, expenditures by advertisers tend to be cyclical, reflecting overall economic conditions and budgeting and buying patterns.' (FY2018 10-K); CYCLICAL: the 10-K says so of its own business ('the cyclicality and seasonality in our business'), the BKR, CAT and NVDA reading, not an industry's words; no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a search and advertising company on these dates (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services; CLOUD, live from 2012-10-30, is scoped to public cloud displacing on-premise IT, and this 10-K names the cloud as Google's own business and its competitors in it ('Providers of enterprise cloud services, including Alibaba, Amazon, and Microsoft.'), so it is out of scope (the AVGO FY2012 and NVDA reading); ECOMMERCE (from 2015-01-01), STREAMING (from 2015-08-04) and ENERGY_TRANSITION (from 2015-12-12) are scoped to physical retail, linear TV and pay-TV bundles, and fossil fuels), so the watch list is empty; the competition named is a competitive field, not a theme, and stays here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -35.4%/yr (worst year FY09-FY18, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +15.6%/yr (Q1 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +17.5%/yr (FY09-FY18 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +25.3%/yr (best 2-yr run FY09-FY18, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: GOOG (retrospective, 2019-06-21) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.45x (70.4% downside to Bear $332.15 / +48.5% upside to Bull $1666.21) | Adj composite 1.95 vs market 2.43: gap -0.48 [MODESTLY OVERVALUED] | +28% above the EPP floor $874.00 (20x FY19E $43.70) | Conservative 2-yr case: +20.7% total (+10.4%/yr) | At 25.7x FY19E the 15% hurdle price $1,483.69 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; revenue +16.7% YoY in Q1 2019, forward revenues +16.7% (Q1 2019 revenue growth (no Q2 2019 guide)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
